facts.detail: Four mobile network operators submitted coverage data.
The mobile data has a reference date of 1 January 2026.
The data is provided under the Open Government Licence.
The UK and nations mobile file contains 1,035 rows.
The schema covers 4G, 5G confidence classes and 5G standalone confidence classes.
Coverage types include premises indoor, premises outdoor and geographic coverage.
Rurality values include total, urban and rural.
Operator values include at least one, all, none and each of the four MNOs.
The local and unitary authority file contains 361 rows.
The Westminster constituency file contains 650 rows.

guard_streams.write_limit: Methodology explains data construction and limitations; it does not establish live service or measured performance for any selected parcel.

facts.detail: The methodology annex was published on 19 November 2025.
The annex explains Ofcom's approach to obtaining and analysing provider information.
Connected Nations uses provider submissions and information already held by Ofcom.
Ofcom uses AddressBase Premium and Islands for the premises base.
Sub-properties within buildings are considered independently of postal delivery-point count.
Connected Nations 2025 used AddressBase Epoch 119.
The annex describes AddressBase as containing information about around 44 million addresses, properties and land areas.
Each AddressBase record refers to a Basic Land and Property Unit.
Each BLPU has a Unique Property Reference Number.
Ofcom combines AddressBase with the May 2025 ONS postcode lookup and Locale urban-rural categories.
